# Where should your wedding budget actually go?

> Free wedding budget calculator: split your total budget across venue, food, photography and more using guest count, region and season, with your top priorities protected and a guest-count suggestion when the budget is tight. Runs in your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
